qualification: The existing diagnostic script is byte-identical in both captures. Both profiles omit [motion], thereby comparing the original V5 implicit path against the new default-direct selector; the separate native strategy scenario tests explicit [motion] strategy="direct".

Baseline and final source hashes differ only at intended composition/backend boundaries. Frozen SDK-free event/action/result traces and normalized executable-loop AST provide exact algorithm-equivalence evidence.
Short workstation timing tails vary; these data do not isolate nanosecond-level wrapper overhead or establish a universal frame-rate guarantee.

Semantic publication-guard rejections are retained in admission counts and never presented as fresh results. There is one during the baseline stationary phase and none in the final capture; neither run reports worker/source failures or work replacements.
Goal errors are endpoint errors under unchanged existing tolerances, not time-parameterized trajectory tracking errors.

native_command_equivalence.scope: Compare all eight matched native requests and complete SkillResult payloads, including step counts and all error/tolerance details. Wall-clock timestamps/durations are intentionally excluded.
native_command_equivalence.qualification: All four stationary result payloads are bit-identical. Moving-phase payloads differ only in tiny endpoint error values, at most 0.0001683 mm and 0.000000303 rad; their step counts, targets, tolerances and success outcomes remain identical. Phase boundaries occur after wall-clock windows, so the number of settling physics updates before the moving phase can vary; these native inputs are not claimed bit-identical. Exact same-input loop behavior is independently established by the frozen SDK-free event/action oracle.
